headlines.title: Shop High Tech Health Gadgets: Bodyscan, Hyperslides, More
headlines.description: Take wellness to the next level with these gadgets to improve health and recovery. Personal tech expert Jennifer Jolly stops by TODAY to share her top healthcare tech picks, including the Wyze Scale Bodyscan, Nike Air Zoom Hyperslides, the Nanoleaf body sculpting massager, and more!

headlines.title: TODAY Anchors Receive Flu Vaccine Shots Live in Studio 1A
headlines.description: The CDC recommends, with rare exceptions, everyone six months and older get vaccinated to protect against the most common types of the flu. CVS pharmacists stop by TODAY to show how quick and easy it is. NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar also joins to break down everything you need to know about this year’s flu season. (Sponsored by CVS Pharmacy)

headlines.title: Pennsylvania reports fourth death linked to measles
headlines.description: Pennsylvania confirmed that a fourth person had died from measles, the first deaths from the virus in 35 years. All of the patients who died were not vaccinated.

headlines.title: Cooling towers at Yankee Stadium test positive for Legionnaires' in new cluster
headlines.description: The New York City Health Department has ordered 10 cooling towers in the South Bronx, including one at Yankee Stadium, to be cleaned and disinfected after preliminary testing found the presence of Legionella bacteria as officials investigate a cluster. NBC News medical contributor Natalie Azar discusses how the test was conducted the possible threat level to attendees.

headlines.title: October Prime Day dates were just announced — here’s everything you need to know
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days is Amazon’s second Prime Day-level sale of 2026 for loyalty members. These are the dates and details to know, plus what to expect.

headlines.title: Early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I found 31+ worth shopping
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days starts on October 6, but early deals are already live. Shop products at least 20% off from Dyson, Garmin, Ninja and more.

headlines.title: Are portable washers and dryers worth the money?
headlines.description: Thinking about a portable washer and dryer for your apartment or small space? We asked appliance experts if they really work, who should buy one and what to consider before shopping.

headlines.title: Is running in the cold dangerous? Experts weigh in
headlines.description: Running experts give tips on how to stay warm while running in cold temperatures and suggest gear that will help you stay comfortable and warm.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania teen dies from measles complications, health officials report
headlines.description: An 18-year-old with measles died from a rare and severe neurological condition that causes inflammation in the brain.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman’s measles death shows risks to people with health problems
headlines.description: The unvaccinated 40-year-old, who died Saturday, had asthma and lung disease, the county coroner’s office said. A test showed the woman tested positive for measles.

headlines.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles complications, state’s third death this year
headlines.description: The 40-year-old woman died as the U.S. experiences its worst outbreak of the disease in 35 years.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who’s feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.
